verdict.rationale: Mirrors stores traces and compares session outcomes, but the evidence never documents an API or MCP server an agent could use to query traces, metrics, or eval results. The mention that a coding agent can write corrections covers authoring corrections, not querying data. The OpenAPI probe found no spec at any candidate path, and llms.txt is a site description rather than a data-query interface.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent query my traces, metrics, and eval results through an API or MCP server to debug my app
